question: How many customers are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer

question: How many artists are in the catalog?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM Artist

question: What is the average track price?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 3) AS average_track_price FROM Track

question: Show the top 5 customers by revenue
gold_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, customer ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show revenue by billing country
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS country, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: How many tracks are in each genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC, genre

question: Which employee supports the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customers_supported FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, employee ORDER BY customers_supported DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the 10 longest tracks by milliseconds?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many invoices were issued in each billing country?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY invoice_count DESC, BillingCountry

question: Which genre has the highest number of tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total invoice revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice

question: How many albums does each artist have?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artist AS ar JOIN Album AS al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY album_count DESC, artist

question: Which media types have the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name AS media_type, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC, media_type

question: List the five most expensive tracks
gold_sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name LIMIT 5

question: How many playlists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS playlist_count FROM Playlist
